name: 1P-AL-LAD
summary: 1P-AL-LAD, also known as 1-propionyl-AL-LAD, is a derivative of lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD) which has psychedelic effects and has been sold as a designer drug. It is believed to act as a prodrug for AL-LAD and produces a head-twitch response in animal studies.
